seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: SoS unofficial primary returns: Valadao 40.7%, Randy Villegas (D) 32.4%, Jasmeet Bains (D) 26.9%. District lines changed under Prop 50. Name: the Fresno Chamber/Fresnoland ballot article lists David G. Valadao, which is used here; verify against the certified list. Valadao birth (April 14, 1977, Hanford) appears in bioguide-style text from search summaries; I could not tell for certain whether it came from history.house.gov, so it is not recorded as a fact. The education attribution to history.house.gov is likewise inferred. Villegas: campaign materials call him Dr. Randy Villegas, but no source found names the doctorate's field or institution, and his college employer was not named. Ballot designations not found.
